projects.name: Quick Pull
projects.subtitle: Real-Time Peer-to-Peer Ride-Sharing System
highlights: MERN-based ride-sharing platform with JWT authentication and live ride tracking.
Route-aware matching and real-time ride updates via OSRM, H3, and Socket.IO.

projects.name: SkillXchange
projects.subtitle: Mutual Mentoring Learning Platform
highlights: Full-stack skill exchange platform with authentication and skill matching.
Integrated Jitsi Meet API for mentoring sessions. Deployed on GitHub Pages and Render.

projects.name: MeshGuard
projects.subtitle: Offline Disaster Rescue & Survivor Tracking App
highlights: Offline-first Android app that relays survivor distress packets phone-to-phone via a gossip mesh.
Survivor/Rescuer roles, background broadcasting, and a rescuer dashboard with an offline map.
